# Toll

> Toll: exact answers for specific jobs, paid per use from one prepaid balance, on the web, over a REST API or through MCP.

Toll is a Conyso product. Every tool is deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer, with no AI model in the loop. Each content page has a Markdown copy at the same address ending in .md.

## Tools

- [1099 threshold tracker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/): Check which payees need a Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC for a payment year, in which box and why: the $2,000 line for 2026 payments, $600 for 2025, royalties at $10 and attorney gross proceeds at $600, with the corporation, card and merchandise exceptions, backup withholding, payees merged by TIN, due dates and an IRIS upload file.
- [Business days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/): Count the business days between two dates, or add business days to a date, for US federal and England and Wales holidays. US holidays are the statutory federal ones only, with no executive-order closures. Add your own days off to skip them too.
- [Delivery date and holiday order-by calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/): Work out when an order arrives, or the last day to order for delivery by a date such as Christmas, from your cutoff time, time zone, shipping days, closures and processing days, on the carrier's own delivery calendar, with USPS's 2026 holiday send-by dates and every skipped holiday named.
- [Exchange rate on a date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/): The official rate for a currency pair on a date, with the date or period actually used. By default the ECB euro reference rate (the latest fixing in the 7 days up to the date, and which); or, with source, the US Treasury reporting rate, the IRS yearly average or the HMRC monthly rate, each named with the publication it came from.
- [Image to size](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/): Shrink a photo to fit under an exact size in KB, such as 50 KB or 200 KB, for upload forms that set a limit. It runs in your browser, so the photo never leaves your device.
- [Mileage reimbursement and IRS mileage log](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/): Price each trip at the IRS mileage rate in force on its date (2026: 72.5 cents to June 30, 76 cents from July 1; medical, moving, charity and GSA rates too), apply Announcement 2026-11's paid-date rule to employer allowances, total a payroll trip sheet per employee with the true-up owed and the W-2 split above the federal rate, and make an IRS-ready vehicle-year log with a Publication 463 completeness check.
- [Tax set-aside per payment](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tax-set-aside/): How much of one payment a self-employed person should set aside for tax, given what they have earned so far this year: US self-employment tax, federal brackets with the QBI deduction and state income tax, or UK Income Tax, Class 4 and student loan, split exactly where the payment crosses a bracket or threshold, with every constant cited.
- [Trucker per diem worksheet](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/): Turn an owner-operator's days on the road into the year's per diem deduction at the IRS transportation-industry rate in force each day ($80 since October 1, 2024; $69 and $66 before), with departure and return days at 3/4, the 80% hours-of-service limit, log checks and a worksheet for the preparer.

## Guides

- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an LLC? (2026 rules)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/llc/): An LLC gets a 1099-NEC at $2,000 for 2026 services unless it is taxed as a corporation. Single-member, partnership and corporate LLCs worked out.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to a corporation? (2026)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/corporation/): Payments to corporations need no 1099, except legal fees, medical payments, attorney proceeds, substitute payments and cash for fish. 2026 cases.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an S corporation? (2026)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/s-corp/): An S corporation, or an LLC taxed as one, gets no 1099 for most payments in 2026; legal fees and medical payments are the exceptions.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an independent contractor?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/independent-contractor/): A contractor paid $2,000 or more in 2026 gets a Form 1099-NEC; $1,999.99 does not. Card payments, payment apps and backup withholding, worked out.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to my property management company?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/property-management-company/): Tenants send no 1099 for rent paid to a property manager. Owners do for management fees of $2,000 or more in 2026 to a non-corporate manager.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my attorney? (2026 rules)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/attorney/): Attorneys get a 1099 even when incorporated: 1099-NEC for fees of $2,000 or more in 2026, 1099-MISC box 10 for settlements and proceeds from $600.
- [Do I have to issue a 1099 to my cleaning lady?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/household-worker/): A 1099 is for business payments, so cleaning your own home needs none; a business that pays a cleaner $2,000 or more in 2026 files Form 1099-NEC. Worked cases.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my landlord? (2026: $2,000 rent)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/landlord/): A business paying $2,000 or more of rent in 2026 to a non-corporate landlord files 1099-MISC box 1. Rent via a manager, to a corporation or for your home: none.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my accountant or CPA?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/accountant-cpa/): Accountants and CPAs get a 1099-NEC for $2,000 or more of business fees in 2026, unless the firm is taxed as a corporation. Each kind of firm worked out.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my insurance company?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/insurance-company/): Premiums paid to an incorporated insurer need no 1099. Commissions of $2,000 or more in 2026 to an unincorporated agent go on Form 1099-NEC.
- [Count business days in Excel with NETWORKDAYS and holidays](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/excel-networkdays/): The exact Excel NETWORKDAYS formula for business days between two dates, with US and England and Wales holiday lists to paste.
- [Add business days to a date in Excel (WORKDAY, with holidays)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/excel-workday/): The exact Excel WORKDAY formula to add or subtract business days, with US and England and Wales holiday lists to paste.
- [Google Sheets NETWORKDAYS and WORKDAY, with holidays](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/google-sheets-networkdays/): Google Sheets formulas to count business days (NETWORKDAYS) and add them to a date (WORKDAY), with US and England and Wales holidays to paste.
- [Business days API: count and add business days over REST or MCP](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/api/): A REST and MCP API that counts or adds business days, skipping US or England and Wales holidays and naming each one. $0.0005 a call.
- [Add business days in Python with holidays (NumPy busday\_offset)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/python/): Add or count business days in Python with NumPy busday\_offset and busday\_count and a US federal holiday list, or call the API.
- [Christmas order deadline banner for Shopify and any store](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/christmas-order-deadline-banner/): How to add a Christmas order-by banner to any store, with deadlines from the store's own cutoff and USPS's 2026 send-by dates.
- [Historical exchange rates in Excel by date, from the ECB file](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/historical-exchange-rates-in-excel/): Look up an ECB rate for any date in Excel with one XLOOKUP, weekends and non-euro pairs included. EUR to USD on 31 December 2025 is 1.1750.
- [Which exchange rate to use for US taxes and the FBAR](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/which-exchange-rate-for-us-taxes/): Which exchange rate each US filing asks for: the spot rate for income and expenses, the IRS yearly averages, and the Treasury 31 December rate for the FBAR.
- [ECB exchange rate API: any date over REST and MCP](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/ecb-exchange-rate-api/): One POST returns the ECB rate for a pair on a date, the fixing actually used and the inverse, for $0.001 a call. AI agents get the same tool over MCP.
- [KB or KiB: is a kilobyte 1,000 or 1,024 bytes on an upload form?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/kb-or-kib/): Why KB can mean 1,000 or 1,024 bytes, with the byte counts for common upload limits under both readings.
- [IRS mileage log requirements 2026 (Pub 463)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/irs-mileage-log-requirements/): The IRS record elements for a mileage log (Pub 463 Table 5-1), when a log counts as timely, and a checker that lists missing elements.
- [Owner-operator per diem deduction: Schedule C line 24b at 80%](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/owner-operator/): How an owner-operator figures and reports the per diem deduction on Schedule C, with the rest requirement and the 80% limit.
- [Per diem partial days: the 3/4 rule for departure and return days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/partial-days/): How departure and return days are prorated at 3/4 of the transportation-industry rate, with the amount for every notice period.
- [Can company truck drivers claim per diem?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/company-drivers/): Why W-2 truck drivers cannot deduct per diem, and how much employer per diem is tax-free under an accountable plan.

## Overviews

- [Holiday shipping deadlines 2026: USPS dates and last order](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/holiday-shipping-deadlines-2026/): USPS 2026 Christmas send-by dates and the last order date for a store's own cutoff and processing days.
- [ECB euro reference rates: the latest fixing for every currency](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/ecb-reference-rates/): The latest ECB euro reference rate for every currency it publishes, with the change from the fixing before and the weekdays with no fixing.
- [EUR to USD exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/eur-usd/): EUR to USD on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.
- [USD to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/usd-inr/): USD to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [USD to CAD exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/usd-cad/): USD to CAD on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.
- [GBP to EUR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/gbp-eur/): GBP to EUR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.
- [EUR to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/eur-inr/): EUR to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [GBP to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/gbp-inr/): GBP to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [Reduce image size in KB: 20 KB to 1 MB, compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/reduce-image-size-in-kb/): How to reduce a photo to a size in KB, with what limits from 20 KB to 1 MB did to four test photos.

## About

- [Tools](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tools/): Every live tool by category, with what it does and its price per use in words.
- [Pricing](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/pricing/): Free use, passes for people, credit packs for code and agents, the team plan, every live tool's price in words, how a charge works, and common questions.
- [How it works](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/how-it-works/): Top up once, use any tool on the web, over REST or over MCP, and pay per use from one balance.
- [Developers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/): The REST API: a quickstart with real requests and responses, API keys, errors, idempotency keys, rate limits, quotes and the OpenAPI document.
- [MCP for AI agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/mcp/): Connect an AI agent over MCP: the server address, authentication, the tools it lists, quote\_price and example calls.
- [Why exact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/why-exact/): Exact answers versus AI guesses, with worked examples from the tools: observed holidays, substitute days, weekend exchange rates and holiday delivery dates.
- [About](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/about/): Who makes the tools and how they work: a small Conyso team, exact tools for specific jobs, no AI in the answers.
- [Who it's for](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/): The tools grouped by who uses them, with a page for each kind of work.
- [For freelancers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/freelancers/): For freelancers and the self-employed: tax set-aside per payment, an IRS mileage log, exchange rates on a date and business-day due dates.
- [For truckers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/truckers/): For owner-operator truckers: the year's per diem worksheet at the IRS transportation rate, and tax set-aside per settlement.
- [For bookkeepers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/bookkeepers/): For bookkeepers and tax preparers: 1099 thresholds with an IRIS file, payroll mileage at the IRS rate by date, per diem worksheets, set-aside and exchange rates.
- [For online sellers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/online-sellers/): For online sellers: delivery and holiday order-by dates, business-day handling times, photos under an upload size and exchange rates on a date.
- [For tax preparers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/tax-preparers/): For tax preparers and enrolled agents: per diem worksheets, mileage logs, 1099 scans and set-aside numbers to check and file from.
- [For gig drivers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/gig-drivers/): For rideshare and delivery drivers: tax set-aside per payout with miles and tips, and miles at the IRS rate with a mileage log.
- [For real estate agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/real-estate-agents/): For real estate agents: tax set-aside per commission check, a mileage log at the IRS rate, and contract deadlines in business days.
- [For nonprofits](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/nonprofits/): For nonprofit treasurers and bookkeepers: mileage at the IRS business and charity rates, and 1099 scans with an IRIS file.
- [For payroll and HR](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/payroll-and-hr/): For payroll and HR: mileage reimbursement sheets at the IRS rate by date, and dates in business days.
- [For small business owners](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/small-business-owners/): For small business owners: 1099 scans for contractors with an IRIS file, and mileage at the IRS rate by date.
- [Docs](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/docs): How to call the tools from code: REST and MCP, authentication, errors, idempotency and limits.
- [Privacy](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/privacy): What Toll stores about visitors and accounts, in plain words.
- [Terms of service](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/terms/): The terms for using Toll: accounts and keys, the prepaid balance, prices, refunds, acceptable use and liability.
- [Refunds and cancellation](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/refunds/): What Toll refunds automatically, how to get unused money back, and how to close an account.
- [Acceptable use](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/acceptable-use/): What Toll may not be used for.
- [Security](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/security/): How Toll protects accounts, keys and balances, and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Contact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/contact/): How to reach Toll for support, billing, privacy and security.
